template.def: Oscillation pattern between Pride and Humility: I must be above others to be worthy, safe, or seen.
template.body:
TERRACE 1: Pride ↔ Humility
DANTE: Purgatorio X–XII. The proud bend beneath stone, while carved examples of humility reverse their former upward self-display. Dante begins the seven-terrace purification here.
LIMITING BELIEF: I must be above others to be worthy, safe, or seen.
REFRAME: My worth is not dependent on rank; I can acknowledge others and still stand firmly.
TRIGGER: Correction, another person receiving credit, losing face, public uncertainty, or comparison to an expert.
VICE MOVEMENT: EXPAND self-image → CONCEAL fallibility → REPEL correction → HOLD position.
CONSTRUCTIVE MOVEMENT: RECEIVE correction → RELEASE status defense → CONNECT as equals → EXPRESS responsibility.
OBSERVABLE VICE: Claims special standing, redirects credit, dismisses criticism, hides mistakes, or insists on being right to preserve rank.
OBSERVABLE CAPACITY: Acknowledges what is true, credits others, asks for correction, admits limits, and holds equal regard without shrinking.
OSCILLATION: Status threat → defensive self-elevation → short relief → damaged mutual trust → more vigilance about rank.
INTEGRATION: Name a correction accurately, credit another person by name, and make one repair without explaining away the impact.
EVIDENCE OF CHANGE: In an actual status threat, receives feedback, credits another, corrects course, and can repeat this without rank restoration.
ALTERNATIVES: Confidence, leadership, disagreement, and healthy pride in real achievement are not this pattern; humiliation or self-erasure is not humility.
ENGINE: read within existing 40–60 Compass median; do not turn terrace into CQ arithmetic or a diagnosis.

template.def: Oscillation pattern between Envy and Charity / Kindness: Someone else receiving goodness reduces what is possible for me.
template.body:
TERRACE 2: Envy ↔ Charity / Kindness
DANTE: Purgatorio XIII–XV. Penitents are seated together with their eyes sewn shut; voices recount acts of selfless love, and Sapia recognizes rejoicing in others’ misfortune.
LIMITING BELIEF: Someone else receiving goodness reduces what is possible for me.
REFRAME: Another person’s success does not cancel my possibility; I can contribute without losing myself.
TRIGGER: A peer succeeds, receives attention, is loved, or gains a resource I wanted.
VICE MOVEMENT: SEEK comparison → CONTRACT possibility → REPEL another’s good → WITHDRAW warmth.
CONSTRUCTIVE MOVEMENT: RECEIVE another’s good → EXPAND possibility → CONNECT → EXPRESS kindness.
OBSERVABLE VICE: Keeps score, discounts achievements, gossips, withdraws goodwill, or gains relief when a rival fails.
OBSERVABLE CAPACITY: Recognizes another person’s good, offers genuine goodwill or help, and acts toward one’s own values without rivalry.
OSCILLATION: Comparison cue → scarcity belief → devaluation or withdrawal → temporary control → increased comparison.
INTEGRATION: State one real thing you value in the other person, offer non-transactional support when appropriate, then take one step toward your own goal.
EVIDENCE OF CHANGE: Can witness a peer’s success without punishment, support their success where appropriate, and keep a clear personal path.
ALTERNATIVES: Recognizing injustice, seeking fairness, or wanting a similar opportunity is not envy; generosity does not require tolerating exploitation.
ENGINE: read within existing 40–60 Compass median; do not turn terrace into CQ arithmetic or a diagnosis.

ENGINE: read within existing 40–60 Compass median; do not turn terrace into CQ arithmetic or a diagnosis.
